subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

narrative.headline: One payment, one truth: every layer of the platform sees the same purchase
narrative.customerProblem: Agentic payments fail when each tool keeps its own copy of what happened, so nobody can prove what was authorized, executed, refused and recovered.
narrative.desiredOutcome: A single exact subject carried through requirement, semantic law, delegation, planning, runtime, process evidence, standing and human views - with typed refusals instead of silent guessing.
narrative.semanticPath: sjira -> graphlaw -> sa2a -> pplan -> xaas -> ex4pm -> beam4pm -> affidavit -> ashsurface -> marketplace

authorityBoundaries: No projection, surface or view grants DO authority; every authority claim is NONE.
No layer inherits standing from a neighboring layer; each layer needs its own exact-subject receipt.
Scenarios are candidate predictions, never observations; refusals are typed, never improvised.
No real payment rail or financial settlement is implied by the Chicago demo subject.

failureRecovery.recovery: Positive path still requires exact-subject execution evidence before any standing beyond UNKNOWN.
Typed refusal above_delegated_limit; buyer may resubmit within the delegated limit; no partial settlement.
Typed refusal wrong_principal; delegation must be re-cut for the actual principal.
Typed refusal delegation_expired; explicit re-delegation, never implicit refresh.
Typed refusal provider_unavailable; bounded replanning over remaining admitted realizations; authority unchanged.
UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH reconciles the original consequence; blind replay is forbidden.
Claimed consequences stay UNKNOWN without exact-subject evidence and receipt.
Stale or mismatched subjects are refused, not generalized to the nearest subject.
Semantic drift invalidates the stale plan; planner re-enters bounded selection.
Human projections re-present state; none may mint authority or alter the exact subject.
